entities.name: Bibi Dokhtaran Mausoleum

entities.summary: The Tomb of Bibi Dokhtaran, also known as the Bibi Dokhtaran Mausoleum, is a mausoleum located in Shiraz, in the province of Fars. Iran. The complex was built during the Ilkhanid era.
